sample: Last five printed lines of scan 14 (printed page 4); convenience sample selected after inspecting OCR. Not random or representative.
checking: Visually transcribed from the bundled scan by the implementing agent and independently checked against the scan by a second read-only reviewing agent. No human annotation. Preserve punctuation, case and printed line-end hyphens; normalize whitespace only.
normalization: Collapse whitespace only; Unicode codepoint CER, whitespace-token WER; Levenshtein distance / reference length.
limitations: Small, post-inspection convenience sample corrected against the same reference; measures this edit only, not general accuracy. Other pages and omitted text are not scored.
